content:
Create a 10-second video using Seedance 2.5., portrait 9:16, using the single-generate function.
OUTPUT
Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical
Lighting: golden hour / sunset
Atmosphere: dramatic, elegant, athletic, celebratory
Sky: vivid fiery sunset clouds with strong orange, red, pink, and purple tones
CORE CREATIVE GOAL
A character stands on an empty runway road at sunset.
From the very opening frame, a very small distant airplane is already visible in the upper-left area of the sky. The airplane flies continuously across the sky along a diagonal left-to-right trajectory while gradually approaching the camera, so its apparent size naturally increases throughout the shot.
The character reacts, runs toward the right side of frame, a black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon enters the composition, the character jumps onto it, then performs a controlled and physically believable ballet Grand Jeté split jump above the vehicle.
At the highest point of the jump, the airplane has naturally reached a position above the airborne character.
At this exact moment, the frame freezes, instantly turns high-contrast black and white, and elegant centered white text appears reading:
"【18】Happy birthday"
The final black-and-white freeze-frame must remain on screen for approximately 2.5–3 seconds, all the way until the video ends.
The final result must feel iconic, realistic, graceful, and poster-worthy.
GLOBAL VISUAL RULES
The video must feel realistic and physically believable, not exaggerated or cartoonish.
The runway must feel open and cinematic, with clear depth into the distance.
Keep the motion elegant and readable.
Hair and clothing should move naturally with the wind, sprint, takeoff, and jump.
The final jump must be athletic and balletic, but also restrained and physically correct.
Do not overstretch the split.
The legs must remain natural, elegant, and believable.
Avoid extreme oversplit, broken anatomy, warped limbs, or deformed legs.
The sky must clearly show a fire-cloud sunset / dramatic glowing sunset cloudscape.
The freeze-frame in the air must include both:
instant black-and-white conversion
centered white text
The final freeze-frame must remain visible for a substantial amount of time and must not flash by too quickly.
SCENE / ENVIRONMENT LOCK
The setting is an empty asphalt runway road stretching into the distance during golden hour sunset.
Key environment details:
The background sky is filled with dramatic fiery sunset clouds
The road is clean, open, and unobstructed
No crowds
No extra cars
No visual clutter
The scene should feel like an airfield / runway environment
The airplane flies at a normal realistic aircraft speed
The environment and aircraft scale must obey believable real-world perspective
VEHICLE LOCK
The vehicle is a black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon
At the opening, the car is not yet visible
The G-Wagon enters the composition only after the character begins moving toward the right side
When visible, the G-Wagon should be shown in a roughly 75-degree three-quarter side view
The car must remain clearly recognizable, premium, and stable in design
The character jumps onto the hood area before launching into the main jump
AIRPLANE LOCK
The airplane must be visible from the very opening frame, already present as a very small distant aircraft in the upper-left area of the sky.
Its flight path must follow realistic three-dimensional perspective and real aircraft physics.
At the opening, the airplane is far away and visually very small, positioned in the upper-left portion of the frame.
It flies continuously through the sky along a diagonal left-to-right trajectory, gradually moving closer to the camera and toward the character's position in the composition.
The airplane is partially approaching the camera, but it must NOT fly directly or perfectly head-on toward the lens.
Its nose and fuselage should maintain a believable oblique flight angle.
It must clearly look like the airplane is traveling across the sky from left to right while simultaneously becoming closer to the camera.
The visible flight path should read as a diagonal line across the sky, rather than a straight frontal approach.
The aircraft must never look like it is simply moving horizontally at a fixed distance.
Because the airplane is physically getting closer during the shot, its apparent size must increase continuously and naturally:
very small at the beginning → progressively larger during the run → clearly larger near the climax
The increase in aircraft size must come from real perspective and decreasing distance, not from an artificial zoom or sudden scale change.
The airplane must travel at a normal, realistic aircraft speed, with smooth continuous motion and believable inertia.
There must be:
no sudden acceleration
no teleporting
no abrupt trajectory change
no sudden scale jump
no unnatural hovering
no artificial camera-facing rotation
Keep the airplane visible throughout the sequence whenever compositionally possible, so its continuous movement from the distant upper-left sky toward the climax can be clearly understood.
FINAL AIRPLANE POSITION LOCK
At the exact peak of the character's Grand Jeté, the airplane must have naturally reached a position directly above the airborne character in the composition.
The final spatial relationship must clearly read:
airplane above → airborne character in the middle → G-Wagon below
At this moment, the airplane should be noticeably larger than it was in the opening frame because it has flown significantly closer, while still remaining realistically positioned in the sky and not appearing unnaturally oversized.
The airplane must still preserve its left-to-right diagonal flight direction at the freeze-frame.
It must not suddenly rotate into a straight nose-on view toward the camera.
AIRPLANE CONTINUITY PRIORITY
The airplane is already visible from the opening frame.
It must not suddenly enter the frame later.
Any later stage described as the airplane becoming more visible or prominent means only that:
the aircraft is getting physically closer
the aircraft is naturally becoming larger
the aircraft is becoming more noticeable in the composition
It does not mean that the airplane first appears later in the sequence.
CHARACTER LOCK
Use the uploaded three-view character reference image as the only source of truth.
Maintain perfect continuity in:
face
Clothing
accessories
hairstyle
body shape
Do not redesign the character.
Do not introduce:
extra limbs
duplicates
identity drift
CAMERA LANGUAGE
Use a smooth cinematic following camera with a low-angle dynamic feel.
The camera should:
begin with a clean runway composition
show the character standing in profile
keep the very small distant airplane visible in the upper-left sky
smoothly follow the action as the character runs toward the right
naturally reveal the G-Wagon as the character approaches it
preserve clear readability of:
the character
the G-Wagon
the airplane
emphasize scale and elegance without feeling chaotic
Camera behavior:
smooth
cinematic
confident
readable
slightly low angle for power and drama
Avoid:
random shaky cam
chaotic whip pans
awkward zooms
distorted perspective
excessive motion blur
The climax may enter subtle slow motion shortly before the airborne peak, but the motion must remain physically believable.
ACTION TIMELINE
0:00–0:01.5 — Opening
Start on the runway road at sunset with a dramatic fire-cloud sky.
The character stands in profile, looking into the distance.
At this moment, the black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon is not yet visible.
The airplane is already visible as a very small distant aircraft in the upper-left area of the sky.
The airplane is not static.
From the opening moment, it is already flying along its continuous diagonal trajectory:
upper left → toward the right side while gradually approaching the camera
Its movement is subtle at first because it is still far away.
0:01.5–0:03.0 — Plane Approach / Character Reaction
The airplane continues its realistic diagonal left-to-right flight path.
As it physically gets closer, it becomes naturally and gradually larger.
It still remains at an oblique angle and does not fly directly toward the lens.
The character notices the airplane, reacts naturally, turns, and begins running toward the right side of frame.
The reaction should be quick and readable without exaggerated acting.
0:03.0–0:05.0 — Run / G-Wagon Reveal
The character accelerates toward the right side of frame.
The camera follows smoothly.
As the character runs, the black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon naturally enters the composition on the right side.
The vehicle must appear at approximately a 75-degree three-quarter side angle.
The airplane remains continuously visible overhead.
It continues:
moving diagonally from left to right
moving closer in three-dimensional space
naturally increasing in apparent size
The airplane and character movement should feel synchronized by real perspective, not artificially choreographed.
0:05.0–0:06.2 — Hood Approach / Step
The character reaches the G-Wagon.
The character jumps onto the hood in a controlled, realistic, physically believable motion.
The foot placement and momentum must make physical sense.
Do not rush the interaction.
Do not make the character magically snap onto the hood.
The hood contact should clearly act as the launch preparation for the next movement.
0:06.2–0:07.2 — Main Grand Jeté
Using the hood as the launch point, the character performs a powerful but restrained ballet Grand Jeté above the G-Wagon.
The jump must be:
elegant
strong
high
physically plausible
athletic
visually clean
not overly exaggerated
The split must remain restrained.
Do not force a perfect 180-degree split if it creates unnatural anatomy.
The legs must remain structurally correct and naturally proportioned.
No:
extreme oversplit
stretched legs
twisted knees
broken hips
warped feet
deformed anatomy

es.content:
Crea un video de 10 segundos usando Seedance 2.5, formato vertical 9:16, utilizando la función de generación única.
OUTPUT
Duración: 10 segundos
Relación de aspecto: 9:16 vertical
Iluminación: golden hour / sunset
Atmósfera: dramática, elegante, atlética, celebratoria
Cielo: nubes de atardecer vívidas y ardientes con fuertes tonos naranja, rojo, rosa y morado
CORE CREATIVE GOAL
Un personaje está de pie sobre una carretera de pista de aterrizaje vacía al atardecer.
Desde el primer fotograma, ya se ve un avión muy pequeño y lejano en la zona superior izquierda del cielo. El avión vuela de forma continua por el cielo siguiendo una trayectoria diagonal de izquierda a derecha mientras se acerca gradualmente a la cámara, de modo que su tamaño aparente aumenta de forma natural a lo largo del plano.
El personaje reacciona, corre hacia el lado derecho del encuadre, entra en la composición un Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon negro, el personaje salta sobre él y luego realiza un Grand Jeté de ballet, controlado y físicamente creíble, en split por encima del vehículo.
En el punto más alto del salto, el avión ha alcanzado de forma natural una posición por encima del personaje en el aire.
En ese momento exacto, el fotograma se congela, se convierte instantáneamente a blanco y negro de alto contraste, y aparece un elegante texto blanco centrado que dice:
"【18】Happy birthday"
El freeze-frame final en blanco y negro debe permanecer en pantalla aproximadamente 2.5–3 segundos, hasta el final del video.
El resultado final debe sentirse icónico, realista, elegante y digno de póster.
GLOBAL VISUAL RULES
El video debe sentirse realista y físicamente creíble, no exagerado ni caricaturesco.
La pista de aterrizaje debe sentirse abierta y cinematográfica, con una profundidad clara hacia la distancia.
Mantén el movimiento elegante y legible.
El cabello y la ropa deben moverse de forma natural con el viento, la carrera, el despegue y el salto.
El salto final debe ser atlético y de ballet, pero también contenido y físicamente correcto.
No exageres el split.
Las piernas deben mantenerse naturales, elegantes y creíbles.
Evita oversplit extremo, anatomía rota, extremidades deformadas o piernas deformadas.
El cielo debe mostrar claramente un sunset de nubes de fuego / un dramático paisaje de nubes resplandecientes al atardecer.
El freeze-frame en el aire debe incluir ambos:
conversión instantánea a blanco y negro
texto blanco centrado
El freeze-frame final debe permanecer visible durante un tiempo sustancial y no debe pasar demasiado rápido.
SCENE / ENVIRONMENT LOCK
La ambientación es una carretera de pista de aterrizaje de asfalto vacía que se extiende hacia la distancia durante la golden hour del atardecer.
Detalles clave del entorno:
El cielo del fondo está lleno de dramáticas nubes ardientes de atardecer
La carretera está limpia, abierta y sin obstrucciones
Sin multitudes
Sin coches extra
Sin elementos visuales que recarguen la escena
La escena debe sentirse como un aeródromo / entorno de pista de aterrizaje
El avión vuela a una velocidad normal y realista de aeronave
La escala del entorno y del avión debe obedecer una perspectiva realista del mundo real
VEHICLE LOCK
El vehículo es un Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon negro
Al inicio, el coche aún no es visible
El G-Wagon entra en la composición solo después de que el personaje comienza a moverse hacia el lado derecho
Cuando sea visible, el G-Wagon debe mostrarse aproximadamente en una vista lateral de tres cuartos a 75 grados
El coche debe seguir siendo claramente reconocible, premium y estable en su diseño
El personaje salta sobre la zona del capó antes de lanzarse al salto principal
AIRPLANE LOCK
El avión debe ser visible desde el fotograma inicial, ya presente como una aeronave muy pequeña y lejana en la zona superior izquierda del cielo.
Su trayectoria de vuelo debe seguir una perspectiva tridimensional realista y la física real de una aeronave.
Al inicio, el avión está muy lejos y visualmente es muy pequeño, situado en la parte superior izquierda del encuadre.
Vuela de forma continua por el cielo siguiendo una trayectoria diagonal de izquierda a derecha, acercándose gradualmente a la cámara y hacia la posición del personaje en la composición.
El avión se aproxima parcialmente a la cámara, pero NO debe volar directamente ni de forma perfectamente frontal hacia el lente.
Su morro y fuselaje deben mantener un ángulo oblicuo creíble de vuelo.
Debe verse claramente que el avión viaja por el cielo de izquierda a derecha mientras al mismo tiempo se acerca a la cámara.
La trayectoria visible debe leerse como una línea diagonal a través del cielo, en lugar de una aproximación frontal recta.
La aeronave nunca debe parecer que simplemente se mueve horizontalmente a una distancia fija.
Como el avión se acerca físicamente durante el plano, su tamaño aparente debe aumentar de forma continua y natural:
muy pequeño al principio → progresivamente más grande durante la carrera → claramente más grande cerca del clímax
El aumento de tamaño de la aeronave debe provenir de la perspectiva real y de la disminución de la distancia, no de un zoom artificial ni de un cambio brusco de escala.
El avión debe viajar a una velocidad normal y realista de aeronave, con un movimiento suave y continuo y una inercia creíble.
Debe haber:
sin aceleración repentina
sin teletransporte
sin cambio brusco de trayectoria
sin salto repentino de escala
sin flotación antinatural
sin rotación artificial hacia la cámara
Mantén el avión visible durante toda la secuencia siempre que sea posible compositivamente, para que su movimiento continuo desde el cielo lejano superior izquierdo hacia el clímax pueda entenderse claramente.
FINAL AIRPLANE POSITION LOCK
En el punto exacto más alto del Grand Jeté del personaje, el avión debe haber alcanzado de forma natural una posición directamente por encima del personaje en el aire dentro de la composición.
La relación espacial final debe leerse claramente:
avión arriba → personaje en el aire en el centro → G-Wagon abajo
En ese momento, el avión debe ser notablemente más grande que en el fotograma inicial porque ha volado significativamente más cerca, aunque sigue estando ubicado de forma realista en el cielo y sin parecer desproporcionadamente grande.
El avión debe conservar todavía su dirección de vuelo diagonal de izquierda a derecha en el freeze-frame.
No debe rotar de repente a una vista frontal directa hacia la cámara.
AIRPLANE CONTINUITY PRIORITY
El avión ya es visible desde el fotograma inicial.
No debe entrar de repente en el encuadre más tarde.
Cualquier etapa posterior descrita como que el avión se vuelve más visible o prominente significa solo que:
la aeronave se está acercando físicamente
la aeronave está aumentando de tamaño de forma natural
la aeronave se está volviendo más notable en la composición
No significa que el avión aparezca por primera vez más adelante en la secuencia.
CHARACTER LOCK
Usa la imagen de referencia del personaje de tres vistas subida como única fuente de verdad.
Mantén una continuidad perfecta en:
rostro
ropa
accesorios
peinado
forma corporal
No rediseñes al personaje.
No introduzcas:
extremidades extra
duplicados
deriva de identidad
CAMERA LANGUAGE
Usa una cámara de seguimiento cinematográfica suave con una sensación dinámica de ángulo bajo.
La cámara debe:
comenzar con una composición limpia de la pista
mostrar al personaje de perfil
mantener visible el avión muy pequeño y lejano en el cielo superior izquierdo
seguir suavemente la acción mientras el personaje corre hacia la derecha
revelar de forma natural el G-Wagon a medida que el personaje se acerca a él
preservar una legibilidad clara de:
el personaje
el G-Wagon
el avión
enfatizar la escala y la elegancia sin sentirse caótica
Comportamiento de cámara:
suave
cinematográfico
seguro
legible
ligeramente en ángulo bajo para dar potencia y dramatismo
Evita:
cámara temblorosa aleatoria
whip pans caóticos
zooms incómodos
perspectiva distorsionada
exceso de motion blur
El clímax puede entrar en un sutil slow motion poco antes del punto más alto en el aire, pero el movimiento debe seguir siendo físicamente creíble.
ACTION TIMELINE
0:00–0:01.5 — Opening
Comienza en la carretera de la pista de aterrizaje al atardecer con un cielo dramático de nubes de fuego.
El personaje está de pie de perfil, mirando a lo lejos.
En este momento, el Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon negro aún no es visible.
El avión ya es visible como una aeronave muy pequeña y lejana en la zona superior izquierda del cielo.
El avión no está estático.
Desde el momento inicial, ya está volando a lo largo de su trayectoria diagonal continua:
arriba a la izquierda → hacia el lado derecho mientras se acerca gradualmente a la cámara
Su movimiento es sutil al principio porque todavía está muy lejos.
0:01.5–0:03.0 — Plane Approach / Character Reaction
El avión continúa su trayectoria de vuelo diagonal realista de izquierda a derecha

fr.content:
Créez une vidéo de 10 secondes en utilisant Seedance 2.5, en format portrait 9:16, avec la fonction de génération unique.

OUTPUT
Durée : 10 secondes
Format : 9:16 vertical
Éclairage : golden hour / coucher de soleil
Atmosphère : dramatique, élégante, athlétique, festive
Ciel : nuages de coucher de soleil flamboyants et vifs, avec de fortes tonalités orange, rouge, rose et violette

CORE CREATIVE GOAL
Un personnage se tient sur une route de piste d’atterrissage vide au coucher du soleil.
Dès le tout premier frame, un très petit avion lointain est déjà visible dans la zone supérieure gauche du ciel. L’avion traverse continuellement le ciel selon une trajectoire diagonale de gauche à droite tout en se rapprochant progressivement de la caméra, de sorte que sa taille apparente augmente naturellement tout au long du plan.
Le personnage réagit, court vers la droite du cadre, une Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon noire entre dans la composition, le personnage saute dessus, puis exécute un Grand Jeté de ballet contrôlé et physiquement crédible en grand écart au-dessus du véhicule.
Au point le plus haut du saut, l’avion a naturellement atteint une position au-dessus du personnage en l’air.
À cet instant précis, l’image se fige, passe instantanément en noir et blanc à fort contraste, et un texte blanc élégant centré apparaît, indiquant :
"【18】Happy birthday"
Le freeze-frame final en noir et blanc doit rester à l’écran pendant environ 2,5 à 3 secondes, jusqu’à la fin de la vidéo.
Le résultat final doit paraître iconique, réaliste, gracieux et digne d’une affiche.

GLOBAL VISUAL RULES
La vidéo doit paraître réaliste et physiquement crédible, sans exagération ni aspect cartoon.
La piste doit sembler ouverte et cinématographique, avec une profondeur claire vers l’arrière-plan.
Gardez le mouvement élégant et lisible.
Les cheveux et les vêtements doivent bouger naturellement avec le vent, la course d’élan et le saut.
Le saut final doit être athlétique et ballettique, mais aussi retenu et physiquement correct.
N’étirez pas excessivement le grand écart.
Les jambes doivent rester naturelles, élégantes et crédibles.
Évitez les oversplits extrêmes, l’anatomie cassée, les membres déformés ou les jambes déformées.
Le ciel doit clairement montrer un coucher de soleil en nuages de feu / un paysage nuageux dramatique et incandescent.
Le freeze-frame en l’air doit inclure les deux éléments suivants :
conversion instantanée en noir et blanc
texte blanc centré
Le freeze-frame final doit rester visible pendant un temps substantiel et ne doit pas défiler trop vite.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT LOCK
Le décor est une route de piste d’atterrissage en asphalte vide s’étendant au loin pendant une golden hour au coucher du soleil.
Détails clés de l’environnement :
Le ciel de fond est rempli de nuages dramatiques et flamboyants de coucher de soleil
La route est propre, ouverte et dégagée
Pas de foule
Pas de voitures supplémentaires
Pas d’encombrement visuel
La scène doit évoquer un aérodrome / une piste d’atterrissage
L’avion vole à une vitesse réaliste normale d’appareil
L’échelle de l’environnement et de l’avion doit respecter une perspective crédible du monde réel

VEHICLE LOCK
Le véhicule est une Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon noire
Au début, la voiture n’est pas encore visible
La G-Wagon n’entre dans la composition qu’après que le personnage commence à se déplacer vers la droite
Lorsqu’elle est visible, la G-Wagon doit être montrée dans une vue trois-quarts latérale d’environ 75 degrés
La voiture doit rester clairement reconnaissable, premium et stable dans son design
Le personnage saute sur la zone du capot avant de lancer le saut principal

AIRPLANE LOCK
L’avion doit être visible dès le tout premier frame, déjà présent comme un très petit appareil lointain dans la zone supérieure gauche du ciel.
Sa trajectoire de vol doit suivre une perspective tridimensionnelle réaliste et une vraie physique aéronautique.
Au début, l’avion est loin et visuellement très petit, positionné dans la partie supérieure gauche du cadre.
Il vole continuellement dans le ciel selon une trajectoire diagonale de gauche à droite, en se rapprochant progressivement de la caméra et de la position du personnage dans la composition.
L’avion s’approche partiellement de la caméra, mais il ne doit PAS voler directement ou parfaitement de face vers l’objectif.
Son nez et son fuselage doivent conserver un angle oblique crédible.
Il doit clairement sembler traverser le ciel de gauche à droite tout en devenant simultanément plus proche de la caméra.
La trajectoire visible doit se lire comme une ligne diagonale à travers le ciel, plutôt qu’une approche frontale directe.
L’appareil ne doit jamais donner l’impression de simplement se déplacer horizontalement à distance fixe.
Comme l’avion se rapproche physiquement pendant le plan, sa taille apparente doit augmenter de façon continue et naturelle :
très petit au début → progressivement plus grand pendant la course → nettement plus grand près du climax
L’augmentation de taille de l’avion doit venir d’une vraie perspective et d’une diminution de la distance, et non d’un zoom artificiel ou d’un changement brusque d’échelle.
L’avion doit se déplacer à une vitesse normale et réaliste, avec un mouvement fluide et continu et une inertie crédible.
Il doit y avoir :
aucune accélération soudaine
aucune téléportation
aucun changement brutal de trajectoire
aucun saut d’échelle soudain
aucune lévitation non naturelle
aucune rotation artificielle face caméra
Gardez l’avion visible tout au long de la séquence lorsque la composition le permet, afin que son mouvement continu depuis le ciel lointain en haut à gauche vers le climax soit clairement compréhensible.

FINAL AIRPLANE POSITION LOCK
Au point exact culminant du Grand Jeté du personnage, l’avion doit avoir naturellement atteint une position directement au-dessus du personnage en l’air dans la composition.
La relation spatiale finale doit se lire clairement :
avion au-dessus → personnage en l’air au milieu → G-Wagon en dessous
À cet instant, l’avion doit être nettement plus grand qu’au frame d’ouverture, car il s’est rapproché de manière significative, tout en restant positionné de façon réaliste dans le ciel et sans paraître anormalement surdimensionné.
L’avion doit conserver sa direction de vol diagonale de gauche à droite au moment du freeze-frame.
Il ne doit pas soudainement pivoter pour adopter une vue de face vers la caméra.

AIRPLANE CONTINUITY PRIORITY
L’avion est déjà visible dès le frame d’ouverture.
Il ne doit pas entrer soudainement dans le cadre plus tard.
Toute étape ultérieure décrite comme rendant l’avion plus visible ou plus proéminent signifie seulement que :
l’appareil se rapproche physiquement
l’appareil devient naturellement plus grand
l’appareil devient plus заметable dans la composition
Cela ne signifie pas que l’avion apparaît pour la première fois plus tard dans la séquence.

CHARACTER LOCK
Utilisez l’image de référence du personnage en trois vues téléchargée comme seule source de vérité.
Maintenez une continuité parfaite dans :
le visage
les vêtements
les accessoires
la coiffure
la morphologie
Ne redessinez pas le personnage.
N’introduisez pas :
de membres supplémentaires
de doublons
de dérive d’identité

CAMERA LANGUAGE
Utilisez une caméra de suivi cinématographique fluide avec une sensation dynamique en contre-plongée.
La caméra doit :
commencer avec une composition propre de la piste
montrer le personnage de profil
garder le très petit avion lointain visible dans le ciel en haut à gauche
suivre en douceur l’action lorsque le personnage court vers la droite
révéler naturellement la G-Wagon à mesure que le personnage s’en approche
préserver une lisibilité claire de :
le personnage
la G-Wagon
l’avion
mettre l’accent sur l’échelle et l’élégance sans donner une impression chaotique
Comportement de la caméra :
fluide
cinématographique
assuré
lisible
légèrement en contre-plongée pour la puissance et le drame
À éviter :
caméra à l’épaule tremblante aléatoire
whip pans chaotiques
zooms maladroits
perspective déformée
flou de mouvement excessif
Le climax peut entrer dans un léger ralenti juste avant le sommet en l’air, mais le mouvement doit rester physiquement crédible.

ACTION TIMELINE
0:00–0:01.5 — Ouverture
Commencez sur la route de piste au coucher du soleil avec un ciel dramatique de nuages de feu.
Le personnage se tient de profil, regardant au loin.
À ce moment, la Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon noire n’est pas encore visible.
L’avion est déjà visible comme un très petit appareil lointain dans la zone supérieure gauche du ciel.
L’avion n’est pas statique.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 を使用して、シングル生成機能で 10 秒の動画を作成してください。ポートレート 9:16。

OUTPUT
Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical
Lighting: golden hour / sunset
Atmosphere: dramatic, elegant, athletic, celebratory
Sky: vivid fiery sunset clouds with strong orange, red, pink, and purple tones

CORE CREATIVE GOAL
A character stands on an empty runway road at sunset.
From the very opening frame, a very small distant airplane is already visible in the upper-left area of the sky. The airplane flies continuously across the sky along a diagonal left-to-right trajectory while gradually approaching the camera, so its apparent size naturally increases throughout the shot.
The character reacts, runs toward the right side of frame, a black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon enters the composition, the character jumps onto it, then performs a controlled and physically believable ballet Grand Jeté split jump above the vehicle.
At the highest point of the jump, the airplane has naturally reached a position above the airborne character.
At this exact moment, the frame freezes, instantly turns high-contrast black and white, and elegant centered white text appears reading:
"【18】Happy birthday"
The final black-and-white freeze-frame must remain on screen for approximately 2.5–3 seconds, all the way until the video ends.
The final result must feel iconic, realistic, graceful, and poster-worthy.

GLOBAL VISUAL RULES
The video must feel realistic and physically believable, not exaggerated or cartoonish.
The runway must feel open and cinematic, with clear depth into the distance.
Keep the motion elegant and readable.
Hair and clothing should move naturally with the wind, sprint, takeoff, and jump.
The final jump must be athletic and balletic, but also restrained and physically correct.
Do not overstretch the split.
The legs must remain natural, elegant, and believable.
Avoid extreme oversplit, broken anatomy, warped limbs, or deformed legs.
The sky must clearly show a fire-cloud sunset / dramatic glowing sunset cloudscape.
The freeze-frame in the air must include both:
instant black-and-white conversion
centered white text
The final freeze-frame must remain visible for a substantial amount of time and must not flash by too quickly.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT LOCK
The setting is an empty asphalt runway road stretching into the distance during golden hour sunset.
Key environment details:
The background sky is filled with dramatic fiery sunset clouds
The road is clean, open, and unobstructed
No crowds
No extra cars
No visual clutter
The scene should feel like an airfield / runway environment
The airplane flies at a normal realistic aircraft speed
The environment and aircraft scale must obey believable real-world perspective

VEHICLE LOCK
The vehicle is a black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon
At the opening, the car is not yet visible
The G-Wagon enters the composition only after the character begins moving toward the right side
When visible, the G-Wagon should be shown in a roughly 75-degree three-quarter side view
The car must remain clearly recognizable, premium, and stable in design
The character jumps onto the hood area before launching into the main jump

AIRPLANE LOCK
The airplane must be visible from the very opening frame, already present as a very small distant aircraft in the upper-left area of the sky.
Its flight path must follow realistic three-dimensional perspective and real aircraft physics.
At the opening, the airplane is far away and visually very small, positioned in the upper-left portion of the frame.
It flies continuously through the sky along a diagonal left-to-right trajectory, gradually moving closer to the camera and toward the character's position in the composition.
The airplane is partially approaching the camera, but it must NOT fly directly or perfectly head-on toward the lens.
Its nose and fuselage should maintain a believable oblique flight angle.
It must clearly look like the airplane is traveling across the sky from left to right while simultaneously becoming closer to the camera.
The visible flight path should read as a diagonal line across the sky, rather than a straight frontal approach.
The aircraft must never look like it is simply moving horizontally at a fixed distance.
Because the airplane is physically getting closer during the shot, its apparent size must increase continuously and naturally:
very small at the beginning → progressively larger during the run → clearly larger near the climax
The increase in aircraft size must come from real perspective and decreasing distance, not from an artificial zoom or sudden scale change.
The airplane must travel at a normal, realistic aircraft speed, with smooth continuous motion and believable inertia.
There must be:
no sudden acceleration
no teleporting
no abrupt trajectory change
no sudden scale jump
no unnatural hovering
no artificial camera-facing rotation
Keep the airplane visible throughout the sequence whenever compositionally possible, so its continuous movement from the distant upper-left sky toward the climax can be clearly understood.

FINAL AIRPLANE POSITION LOCK
At the exact peak of the character's Grand Jeté, the airplane must have naturally reached a position directly above the airborne character in the composition.
The final spatial relationship must clearly read:
airplane above → airborne character in the middle → G-Wagon below
At this moment, the airplane should be noticeably larger than it was in the opening frame because it has flown significantly closer, while still remaining realistically positioned in the sky and not appearing unnaturally oversized.
The airplane must still preserve its left-to-right diagonal flight direction at the freeze-frame.
It must not suddenly rotate into a straight nose-on view toward the camera.

AIRPLANE CONTINUITY PRIORITY
The airplane is already visible from the opening frame.
It must not suddenly enter the frame later.
Any later stage described as the airplane becoming more visible or prominent means only that:
the aircraft is getting physically closer
the aircraft is naturally becoming larger
the aircraft is becoming more noticeable in the composition
It does not mean that the airplane first appears later in the sequence.

CHARACTER LOCK
Use the uploaded three-view character reference image as the only source of truth.
Maintain perfect continuity in:
face
Clothing
accessories
hairstyle
body shape
Do not redesign the character.
Do not introduce:
extra limbs
duplicates
identity drift

CAMERA LANGUAGE
Use a smooth cinematic following camera with a low-angle dynamic feel.
The camera should:
begin with a clean runway composition
show the character standing in profile
keep the very small distant airplane visible in the upper-left sky
smoothly follow the action as the character runs toward the right
naturally reveal the G-Wagon as the character approaches it
preserve clear readability of:
the character
the G-Wagon
the airplane
emphasize scale and elegance without feeling chaotic
Camera behavior:
smooth
cinematic
confident
readable
slightly low angle for power and drama
Avoid:
random shaky cam
chaotic whip pans
awkward zooms
distorted perspective
excessive motion blur
The climax may enter subtle slow motion shortly before the airborne peak, but the motion must remain physically believable.

ACTION TIMELINE
0:00–0:01.5 — Opening
Start on the runway road at sunset with a dramatic fire-cloud sky.
The character stands in profile, looking into the distance.
At this moment, the black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon is not yet visible.
The airplane is already visible as a very small distant aircraft in the upper-left area of the sky.
The airplane is not static.
From the opening moment, it is already flying along its continuous diagonal trajectory:
upper left → toward the right side while gradually approaching the camera
Its movement is subtle at first because it is still far away.
0:01.5–0:03.0 — Plane Approach / Character Reaction
The airplane continues its realistic diagonal left-to-right flight path.
As it physically gets closer, it becomes naturally and gradually larger.
It still remains at an oblique angle and does not fly directly toward the lens.
The character notices the airplane, reacts naturally, turns, and begins running toward the right side of frame.
The reaction should be quick and readable without exaggerated acting.
0:03.0–0:05.0 — Run / G-Wagon Reveal
The character accelerates toward the right side of frame.
The camera follows smoothly.
As the character runs, the black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon naturally enters the composition on the right side.
The vehicle must appear at approximately a 75-degree three-quarter side angle.
The airplane remains continuously visible overhead.
It continues:
moving diagonally from left to right
moving closer in three-dimensional space
naturally increasing in apparent size
The airplane and character movement should feel synchronized by real perspective, not artificially choreographed.
0:05.0–0:06.2 — Hood Approach / Step
The character reaches the G-Wagon.
The character jumps onto the hood in a controlled, realistic, physically believable motion.
The foot placement and momentum must make physical sense.
Do not rush the interaction.
Do not make the character magically snap onto the hood.
The hood contact should clearly act as the launch preparation for the next movement.
0:06.2–0:07.2 — Main Grand Jeté
Using the hood as the launch point, the character performs a powerful but restrained ballet Grand Jeté above the G-Wagon.
The jump must be:
elegant
strong
high
physically plausible
athletic
visually clean
not overly exaggerated
The split must remain restrained.
Do not force a perfect 180-degree split if it creates unnatural anatomy.
The legs must remain structurally correct and naturally proportioned.
No:
extreme oversplit
stretched legs
twisted knees
broken hips
warped feet
deformed anatomy

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5를 사용하여 10초짜리 영상을 만드세요. 세로형 9:16, single-generate 기능 사용.

OUTPUT
Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical
Lighting: golden hour / sunset
Atmosphere: dramatic, elegant, athletic, celebratory
Sky: vivid fiery sunset clouds with strong orange, red, pink, and purple tones

CORE CREATIVE GOAL
한 캐릭터가 석양의 텅 빈 활주로 도로 위에 서 있다.
첫 프레임부터, 아주 작은 먼 비행기가 이미 하늘의 왼쪽 상단 영역에 보인다. 비행기는 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 대각선 궤적을 따라 하늘을 가로질러 계속 비행하면서 점차 카메라에 가까워지고, 그에 따라 샷 전체에서 보이는 크기가 자연스럽게 커진다.
캐릭터가 반응해 프레임 오른쪽으로 달려가고, 검은색 Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon이 화면에 들어오며, 캐릭터가 그 위로 뛰어오른 뒤, 차량 위에서 통제되고 물리적으로 그럴듯한 발레 Grand Jeté 스플릿 점프를 수행한다.
점프의 가장 높은 지점에서, 비행기는 자연스럽게 공중에 있는 캐릭터 위쪽 위치에 도달해 있다.
이 정확한 순간, 프레임이 정지하고 즉시 고대비 흑백으로 전환되며, 중앙에 우아한 흰색 텍스트가 나타나 다음과 같이 읽힌다:
"【18】Happy birthday"
최종 흑백 정지 프레임은 영상이 끝날 때까지 약 2.5~3초 동안 화면에 유지되어야 한다.
최종 결과는 아이코닉하고, 현실적이며, 우아하고, 포스터에 어울리는 느낌이어야 한다.

GLOBAL VISUAL RULES
영상은 과장되거나 만화 같지 않고, 현실적이며 물리적으로 그럴듯해야 한다.
활주로는 깊이가 분명하게 느껴지는, 탁 트이고 시네마틱한 공간이어야 한다.
움직임은 우아하고 읽기 쉬워야 한다.
머리카락과 의상은 바람, 전력 질주, 도약, 점프에 따라 자연스럽게 움직여야 한다.
마지막 점프는 운동적이고 발레적이어야 하지만, 동시에 절제되고 물리적으로 정확해야 한다.
스플릿을 과도하게 벌리지 말 것.
다리는 자연스럽고 우아하며 그럴듯해야 한다.
극단적인 oversplit, 부러진 해부학, 뒤틀린 팔다리, 변형된 다리는 피할 것.
하늘에는 분명히 fire-cloud sunset / dramatic glowing sunset cloudscape가 보여야 한다.
공중에서의 freeze-frame에는 다음 두 가지가 모두 포함되어야 한다:
즉시 흑백 전환
중앙 정렬된 흰색 텍스트
최종 freeze-frame은 충분히 긴 시간 동안 보여야 하며, 너무 빨리 지나가면 안 된다.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT LOCK
배경은 golden hour sunset 동안 끝없이 멀리 뻗어 나가는 텅 빈 아스팔트 활주로 도로다.
핵심 환경 디테일:
배경 하늘은 극적인 불타는 석양 구름으로 가득 차 있다
도로는 깨끗하고, 탁 트여 있으며, 장애물이 없다
군중 없음
추가 차량 없음
시각적 잡동사니 없음
장면은 비행장 / 활주로 환경처럼 느껴져야 한다
비행기는 정상적인 현실적인 항공기 속도로 비행한다
환경과 항공기의 스케일은 현실 세계의 그럴듯한 원근을 따라야 한다

VEHICLE LOCK
차량은 검은색 Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon이다
오프닝에서는 차가 아직 보이지 않는다
G-Wagon은 캐릭터가 프레임 오른쪽으로 움직이기 시작한 뒤에만 화면에 들어온다
보일 때 G-Wagon은 대략 75도 정도의 3/4 측면 뷰로 보여야 한다
차는 분명히 알아볼 수 있어야 하며, 프리미엄하고 안정적인 디자인이어야 한다
캐릭터는 메인 점프로 도약하기 전에 먼저 보닛 부분 위로 뛰어올라야 한다

AIRPLANE LOCK
비행기는 반드시 첫 프레임부터 보여야 하며, 이미 하늘의 왼쪽 상단 영역에 있는 아주 작은 먼 항공기로 존재해야 한다.
그 비행 경로는 현실적인 3차원 원근과 실제 항공기 물리를 따라야 한다.
오프닝에서 비행기는 멀리 있고 시각적으로 매우 작으며, 프레임의 왼쪽 상단에 위치한다.
비행기는 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 향하는 대각선 궤적을 따라 하늘을 계속 가로지르며, 점차 카메라와 캐릭터의 위치 쪽으로 가까워진다.
비행기는 카메라 쪽으로 일부 접근하고 있지만, 렌즈를 향해 직접적이거나 완벽하게 정면으로 날아오면 안 된다.
기수와 동체는 그럴듯한 비스듬한 비행 각도를 유지해야 한다.
비행기가 하늘을 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 가로지르면서 동시에 카메라에 가까워지고 있다는 것이 분명히 보여야 한다.
보이는 비행 경로는 직선적인 정면 접근이 아니라, 하늘을 가로지르는 대각선 선처럼 읽혀야 한다.
항공기는 단순히 고정된 거리에서 수평으로만 움직이는 것처럼 보여서는 안 된다.
샷 동안 비행기가 물리적으로 가까워지고 있으므로, 그 보이는 크기는 지속적이고 자연스럽게 증가해야 한다:
처음에는 매우 작게 → 달리는 동안 점차 커짐 → 클라이맥스에 가까워질수록 분명히 더 커짐
항공기의 크기 증가는 인위적인 줌이나 갑작스러운 스케일 변화가 아니라, 실제 원근과 거리 감소에서 비롯되어야 한다.
비행기는 정상적이고 현실적인 항공기 속도로, 부드럽고 연속적인 움직임과 그럴듯한 관성을 가져야 한다.
다음은 없어야 한다:
갑작스러운 가속
순간이동
급격한 궤적 변화
갑작스러운 스케일 점프
부자연스러운 호버링
인위적인 카메라 정면 회전
구성이 허용하는 한, 시퀀스 전반에 걸쳐 비행기가 계속 보이도록 하여, 멀리 있는 왼쪽 상단 하늘에서 클라이맥스까지 이어지는 연속적인 움직임이 분명히 이해되게 해야 한다.

FINAL AIRPLANE POSITION LOCK
캐릭터의 Grand Jeté가 정확히 최고점에 도달했을 때, 비행기는 자연스럽게 공중에 있는 캐릭터의 바로 위 위치에 도달해야 한다.
최종 공간 관계는 다음처럼 분명하게 읽혀야 한다:
비행기 위 → 공중의 캐릭터 가운데 → 아래의 G-Wagon
이 순간 비행기는 오프닝 프레임보다 눈에 띄게 더 커져 있어야 한다. 이는 실제로 훨씬 가까워졌기 때문이어야 하며, 동시에 여전히 현실적으로 하늘에 위치하고 있어야 하고 부자연스럽게 과도하게 커 보이면 안 된다.
비행기는 freeze-frame에서도 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 향하는 대각선 비행 방향을 유지해야 한다.
갑자기 카메라를 향한 정면 노즈온 뷰로 회전해서는 안 된다.

AIRPLANE CONTINUITY PRIORITY
비행기는 이미 오프닝 프레임에서 보인다.
나중에 갑자기 프레임에 들어오면 안 된다.
이후 단계에서 비행기가 더 잘 보이거나 더 두드러진다고 설명되는 것은 오직 다음을 의미한다:
항공기가 물리적으로 더 가까워지고 있다
항공기가 자연스럽게 더 커지고 있다
항공기가 구도에서 더 눈에 띄게 되고 있다
이는 비행기가 시퀀스 후반에 처음 나타난다는 뜻이 아니다.

CHARACTER LOCK
업로드된 3뷰 캐릭터 레퍼런스 이미지를 유일한 기준으로 사용한다.
다음 요소의 연속성을 완벽하게 유지할 것:
얼굴
의상
액세서리
헤어스타일
체형
캐릭터를 재디자인하지 말 것.
다음을 도입하지 말 것:
추가 팔다리
복제
정체성 드리프트

CAMERA LANGUAGE
부드러운 시네마틱 팔로잉 카메라를 사용하고, 로우 앵글의 다이내믹한 느낌을 준다.
카메라는 다음을 해야 한다:

pt.content:
Crie um vídeo de 10 segundos usando Seedance 2.5., formato retrato 9:16, usando a função de geração única.
OUTPUT
Duração: 10 segundos
Proporção: 9:16 vertical
Iluminação: golden hour / pôr do sol
Atmosfera: dramática, elegante, atlética, celebratória
Céu: nuvens de pôr do sol vívidas e em chamas, com fortes tons de laranja, vermelho, rosa e roxo
CORE CREATIVE GOAL
Um personagem está em uma estrada de pista de pouso vazia ao pôr do sol.
Desde o primeiro frame, um avião muito pequeno e distante já está visível na área superior esquerda do céu. O avião voa continuamente pelo céu em uma trajetória diagonal da esquerda para a direita, aproximando-se gradualmente da câmera, de modo que seu tamanho aparente aumenta naturalmente ao longo da cena.
O personagem reage, corre para o lado direito do quadro, um Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon preto entra na composição, o personagem salta sobre ele e então executa um Grand Jeté de balé, um salto em espacate, controlado e fisicamente crível, acima do veículo.
No ponto mais alto do salto, o avião já terá chegado naturalmente a uma posição acima do personagem no ar.
Nesse exato momento, o quadro congela, vira instantaneamente preto e branco de alto contraste, e aparece um texto branco elegante e centralizado com a leitura:
"【18】Happy birthday"
O freeze-frame final em preto e branco deve permanecer na tela por aproximadamente 2,5 a 3 segundos, até o vídeo terminar.
O resultado final deve parecer icônico, realista, gracioso e digno de pôster.
GLOBAL VISUAL RULES
O vídeo deve parecer realista e fisicamente crível, não exagerado nem cartunesco.
A pista de pouso deve parecer aberta e cinematográfica, com profundidade clara até o horizonte.
Mantenha o movimento elegante e legível.
Cabelo e roupa devem se mover naturalmente com o vento, a corrida, a impulsão e o salto.
O salto final deve ser atlético e balético, mas também contido e fisicamente correto.
Não force demais o espacate.
As pernas devem permanecer naturais, elegantes e críveis.
Evite oversplit extremo, anatomia quebrada, membros deformados ou pernas distorcidas.
O céu deve mostrar claramente um sunset de fire-cloud / uma dramática paisagem de nuvens luminosas ao pôr do sol.
O freeze-frame no ar deve incluir ambos:
conversão instantânea para preto e branco
texto branco centralizado

AIRPLANE LOCK
O avião deve estar visível desde o frame inicial, já presente como uma aeronave muito pequena e distante na área superior esquerda do céu.

No início, o avião está longe e visualmente muito pequeno, posicionado na porção superior esquerda do quadro.
Ele voa continuamente pelo céu em uma trajetória diagonal da esquerda para a direita, aproximando-se gradualmente da câmera e da posição do personagem na composição.
O avião está se aproximando parcialmente da câmera, mas NÃO deve voar diretamente nem perfeitamente de frente para a lente.

A trajetória visível deve ser lida como uma linha diagonal pelo céu, e não como uma aproximação frontal reta.
A aeronave nunca deve parecer estar apenas se movendo horizontalmente a uma distância fixa.
Como o avião está fisicamente se aproximando durante a cena, seu tamanho aparente deve aumentar de forma contínua e natural:
muito pequeno no começo → progressivamente maior durante a corrida → claramente maior perto do clímax
O aumento de tamanho da aeronave deve vir da perspectiva real e da diminuição da distância, não de um zoom artificial ou de uma mudança súbita de escala.
O avião deve viajar a uma velocidade normal e realista, com movimento suave e contínuo e inércia crível.
Deve haver:
nenhuma aceleração súbita
nenhum teletransporte
nenhuma mudança abrupta de trajetória
nenhum salto súbito de escala
nenhuma flutuação artificial
nenhuma rotação artificial voltada para a câmera
Mantenha o avião visível durante toda a sequência sempre que a composição permitir, para que seu movimento contínuo do céu distante no canto superior esquerdo até o clímax possa ser claramente compreendido.
FINAL AIRPLANE POSITION LOCK
No exato ápice do Grand Jeté do personagem, o avião deve ter chegado naturalmente a uma posição diretamente acima do personagem no ar na composição.
A relação espacial final deve ser claramente lida como:
avião acima → personagem no ar no meio → G-Wagon abaixo
Nesse momento, o avião deve estar visivelmente maior do que no frame inicial, porque voou significativamente mais perto, embora ainda permaneça posicionado de forma realista no céu e sem parecer desproporcionalmente grande.
O avião ainda deve preservar sua direção diagonal de voo da esquerda para a direita no freeze-frame.
Ele não deve girar de repente para uma vista frontal direta em direção à câmera.
AIRPLANE CONTINUITY PRIORITY
O avião já está visível desde o frame inicial.
Ele não deve entrar de repente no quadro mais tarde.
Qualquer estágio posterior descrito como o avião ficando mais visível ou proeminente significa apenas que:

a aeronave está naturalmente ficando maior
a aeronave está se tornando mais perceptível na composição
Isso não significa que o avião apareça pela primeira vez mais tarde na sequência.

A câmera deve:

使用 Seedance 2.5 创建一个 10 秒视频，竖屏 9:16，使用单次生成（single-generate）功能。  
输出  
时长：10 秒  
画幅比例：9:16 竖屏  
光照：golden hour / sunset  
氛围：戏剧性、优雅、运动感、庆祝感  
天空：鲜艳炽烈的日落云层，带有强烈的橙色、红色、粉色和紫色调  

核心创意目标  
一个角色站在日落时分空旷的跑道公路上。  
从最开头的画面起，天空左上区域已经能看到一架非常小、很远的飞机。飞机沿着从左到右的对角线轨迹持续飞行，同时逐渐接近镜头，因此在整个镜头中其表观尺寸会自然增大。  
角色做出反应，向画面右侧跑去，一辆黑色 Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon 进入画面，角色跳上车，然后在车辆上方完成一个受控且符合物理逻辑的芭蕾 Grand Jeté 劈叉跳。  
在跳跃的最高点，飞机已经自然到达空中角色上方的位置。  
就在这一瞬间，画面冻结，瞬间转为高对比黑白，并出现居中优雅的白色文字：  
"【18】Happy birthday"  
最终的黑白冻结画面必须持续显示约 2.5–3 秒，一直到视频结束。  
最终效果必须具有标志性、真实、优雅、适合海报的质感。  

全局视觉规则  
视频必须感觉真实且符合物理规律，不能夸张或卡通化。  
跑道必须显得开阔且具有电影感，远处有清晰的纵深。  
保持动作优雅且易读。  
头发和衣物应随着风、冲刺、起跳和跳跃自然摆动。  
最终跳跃必须兼具运动感与芭蕾感，但也要克制并符合物理规律。  
不要过度拉伸劈叉。  
腿部必须保持自然、优雅且可信。  
避免极端超劈叉、断裂般的解剖结构、扭曲的四肢或变形的腿。  
天空必须清晰呈现火云日落 / 戏剧性发光的日落云景。  
空中冻结画面必须同时包含：  
瞬间黑白转换  
居中文字  
最终冻结画面必须持续足够长时间，不能一闪而过。  

场景 / 环境锁定  
场景设定为 golden hour 日落时分，一条空旷的沥青跑道公路向远处延伸。  
关键环境细节：  
背景天空充满戏剧性的炽烈日落云层  
道路干净、开阔、没有障碍物  
没有人群  
没有额外车辆  
没有视觉杂乱  
场景应呈现机场跑道 / 飞行场环境的感觉  
飞机以正常、真实的飞机速度飞行  
环境与飞机的尺度必须符合可信的现实透视关系  

车辆锁定  
车辆为黑色 Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon  
开头时，汽车尚不可见  
G-Wagon 只在角色开始向画面右侧移动后才进入画面  
当可见时，G-Wagon 应以大约 75 度的三分之四侧面视角呈现  
车辆必须保持清晰可辨、质感高级且设计稳定  
角色应先跳到引擎盖区域，再发力进入主要跳跃  

飞机锁定  
飞机必须从最开头的画面就可见，已经作为一架非常小、很远的飞机出现在天空左上区域。  
它的飞行路径必须遵循真实的三维透视和真实的飞机物理规律。  
开头时，飞机距离很远，视觉上非常小，位于画面左上方。  
它沿着从左到右的对角线轨迹持续飞行，同时逐渐靠近镜头并朝角色在构图中的位置移动。  
飞机是在部分接近镜头，但绝不能直接或完全正对镜头飞来。  
其机头和机身应保持可信的斜向飞行角度。  
它必须清楚地看起来是在从左向右穿越天空，同时又在逐渐靠近镜头。  
可见的飞行路径应读作天空中的一条对角线，而不是正面直线逼近。  
飞机绝不能看起来只是以固定距离水平移动。  
由于飞机在镜头中实际越来越近，其表观尺寸必须持续且自然地增大：  
开头非常小 → 在奔跑过程中逐渐变大 → 在高潮前明显更大  
飞机尺寸的增加必须来自真实透视和距离缩短，而不是人为缩放或突然变大。  
飞机必须以正常、真实的飞行速度移动，动作平滑连续，并具有可信的惯性。  
必须做到：  
没有突然加速  
没有瞬移  
没有轨迹突变  
没有突然的尺寸跳变  
没有不自然的悬停  
没有人为的朝镜头旋转  
在构图允许的情况下，飞机应始终保持可见，以便清楚理解其从远处左上天空向高潮位置持续移动的过程。  

最终飞机位置锁定  
在角色 Grand Jeté 的最高点，飞机必须自然到达构图中空中角色正上方的位置。  
最终空间关系必须清晰呈现为：  
飞机在上方 → 空中角色在中间 → G-Wagon 在下方  
在这一时刻，飞机应比开头画面明显更大，因为它已经飞近了许多，但仍必须保持在天空中的真实位置，不能显得异常巨大。  
在冻结画面中，飞机仍必须保持从左到右的对角飞行方向。  
它不能突然旋转成正对镜头的机头视角。  

飞机连续性优先级  
飞机从开头画面就已经可见。  
它不能在后面才突然进入画面。  
后续阶段若描述为飞机变得更明显或更突出，含义仅是：  
飞机在物理上更接近了  
飞机自然变大了  
飞机在构图中更显眼了  
这并不意味着飞机是在序列后段才首次出现。  

角色锁定  
仅使用上传的三视图角色参考图作为唯一真实依据。  
在以下方面保持完全连续性：  
面部  
服装  
配饰  
发型  
体型  
不要重新设计角色。  
不要引入：  
额外肢体  
重复角色  
身份漂移  

镜头语言  
使用平滑的电影感跟拍镜头，并带有低机位的动态感。  
镜头应：  
以干净的跑道构图开始  
展示角色的侧面站姿  
保持左上天空中那架非常小、很远的飞机可见  
在角色向右奔跑时平滑跟随动作  
自然展现 G-Wagon 随着角色接近而进入画面  
保持以下元素清晰可读：  
角色  
G-Wagon  
飞机  
在不显得混乱的前提下强调尺度与优雅  
镜头行为：  
平滑  
电影感  
稳定自信  
易读  
略低机位以增强力量感和戏剧性  
避免：  
随机抖动镜头  
混乱的甩镜  
别扭的变焦  
透视失真  
过度运动模糊  
高潮前可进入轻微慢动作，但动作仍必须符合物理规律。  

动作时间线  
0:00–0:01.5 — 开场  
在日落时分的跑道公路上开始，天空呈现戏剧性的火云。  
角色侧身站立，望向远方。  
此时黑色 Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon 尚不可见。  
飞机已经作为一架非常小、很远的飞机出现在天空左上区域。  
飞机不是静止的。  
从开头那一刻起，它就已经沿着连续的对角线轨迹飞行：  
左上 → 朝画面右侧，同时逐渐接近镜头  
由于它仍然很远，起初移动会显得较为轻微。  

0:01.5–0:03.0 — 飞机接近 / 角色反应  
飞机继续以真实的对角线从左向右飞行。  
随着它在物理上越来越近，它会自然、逐渐地变大。  
它仍保持斜向角度，不会直接朝镜头飞来。  
角色注意到飞机，做出自然反应，转身并开始向画面右侧奔跑。  
反应应快速且易读，不要夸张表演。
